description: Ten candidate contractor pain-point scenarios; automated regressions are not contractor acceptance.

targets.name: Stale quotations not followed up
targets.pattern: completion, future dates, invalid dates and confirmed handoffs
targets.executionScope: Owner-reviewed quote follow-up task and contact attempt/reached outcome; quote-linked task closure and audit commit; no external send
targets.resolutionCriterion: Only an owner-attested reached contact with linked evidence closes open follow-up tasks; attempted contact records activity but does not close tasks; provider delivery remains unverified
targets.verification: 33/33 exact-GitHub-source tests passed in an isolated JavaScript host with Node API shims; full Node, real IndexedDB, Playwright and real contractor outcome remain unverified

targets.name: Overdue invoice balances overlooked
targets.executionScope: owner-approved internal task creation with payment snapshot, idempotency and audited reconciliation; no customer outreach or bank verification
targets.verification: source implementation committed; real browser, Node suite and contractor outcome not yet verified

targets.name: Scheduling conflicts missed
targets.executionScope: standalone calendar event overlap reschedule only; approved, snapshot guarded and atomic, with calendar audit and nonreplaying recovery; linked jobs and tasks remain review-only
targets.verification: source committed with isolated parse, conflict and transaction checks; full Node/browser/contractor acceptance pending

targets.name: Unapproved job changes forgotten
targets.executionScope: owner-approved persistent internal change-order authorization-review task; never marks customer approval or authorizes extra work
targets.resolutionCriterion: a recorded customer authorization with verifiable evidence is still required before extra work is treated as approved; this task only prompts that review
targets.mappingScope: partial: internal review and auditable task creation do not yet verify customer approval or prevent field work
targets.verification: focused local Node regression passed; exact-head CI and Chromium scenario pending

targets.name: Job spending exceeds budget unnoticed
targets.mappingScope: partial: recorded overrun detection does not prove complete job profitability

targets.name: Invoice payment discrepancies overlooked
targets.mappingScope: adjacent: payment discrepancy alerts do not integrate accounting and operations systems

targets.name: Re-entering estimates without safe quote reuse
Customer account economics unclear
targets.pattern: customer account economics sums local receipts
